name: WF-SLA — یادآوری، هشدار و گزارش هفتگی

parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.public_ref, t.category, t.created_at, s.telegram_chat_id, s.name AS staff_name FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.status = 'open' AND t.first_reply_at IS NULL AND t.created_at <= now() - interval '4 hours' AND t.created_at > now() - interval '5 hours'

SELECT t.id, t.public_ref, t.category, t.created_at FROM tickets t WHERE t.status = 'open' AND t.first_reply_at IS NULL AND t.created_at <= now() - interval '24 hours' AND t.created_at > now() - interval '25 hours'
SELECT telegram_chat_id FROM staff WHERE category = 'مدیر' AND telegram_chat_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT category, count(*) AS total FROM tickets WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY category ORDER BY total DESC
